title: Asymptotically-FLRW$_3$ spacetimes
summary: We introduce three-dimensional asymptotically-FLRW spacetimes as a simplified setting in which to study asymptotic symmetries and radiation in cosmology. Their asymptotic symmetry group is $\text{BMS}_3^k$, a one-parameter deformation of $\text{BMS}_3$ controlled by the matter equation of state with parameter $k$, in line with the four-dimensional construction of Bonga and Prabhu. We analyze in detail the case of a scalar field matter source, which allows us to fully characterize the solution space and the boundary charges.
